## DIMCID vs CupodBot — ANALYSIS (verdict: open_blocked, outcome (C,C))

Bots (both search, both const branches, then=D else=C):
- CupodBot k: guard = plays opp self D. vs DIMCID substitutes to B := plays (DIMCID k)(CupodBot k) D. then=D else=C.
- DIMCID k: guard = (plays self opp C) -> (plays opp self D). vs Cupod substitutes to
  guard := (P -> A) where P := plays (DIMCID k)(CupodBot k) C, A := plays (CupodBot k)(DIMCID k) D. then=D else=C.

Both LEGS build fine (searchBranch):
- dc_cupod_leg: □_k B -> A   (Pf.searchBranch k (plays opp self D) D C (CupodBot k)(DIMCID k) rfl; simpa[CupodBot,Formula.subst,Prog.subst])
- dc_dimcid_leg: □_k guard -> B   (Pf.searchBranch k (impl (plays self opp C)(plays opp self D)) D C (DIMCID k)(CupodBot k) rfl; simpa[DIMCID,...])

WHY (D,D) IS BLOCKED (guard-box wall): mutual_pblt/mutual_loeb needs leg1 = □_k A -> B.
Have □_k guard -> B. Need □_k A -> □_k guard. guard = P->A, have ⊢ A->guard (implK A P), box+axK gives
□_b A -> □_c guard with gate a'+b+|guard| <= c, forcing c > k. But dimcid leg reads guard box only at
exactly k (searchBranch subscript = bot's search budget k). Can't lower c->k (downward boxMono unsound).
CONFIRMED by run_lean (axK gate forces c>k). So (D,D) not derivable with current rules.

WHY (C,C) census is BLOCKED: excluded facts are the D-PLAYS (A, B) which are the searchers' THEN-branches
(readable via searchBranch conditional on guard box) — NOT else-branches, so NO search_f FLOOR applies.
- no_provable_searcherPlay_tail needs guard interp FALSE independently — circular (guard reduces to interp A).
- WV census (wv_sound_upto) only ADDS truth to C-atoms; my excluded atoms are D-plays: WV S (plays P Q D)
  = interp(plays P Q D). Making C-atoms true doesn't force D-atoms false. For DIMCID's guard P->A:
  WV = (WV P)->(interp A) = interp A — still reduces to interp A. NO valuation in the master makes
  entangled D-atoms false. This is the DUAL of WaryBot (WaryBot's excluded thing was .neg(C-atom), which
  WV kills; here it's a D-play, which WV cannot). No kernel handles the entangled-THEN-play fixpoint.

Semantically DETERMINED (C,C): guards unprovable (descending-budget: guard->A->□B->B->guard at strictly
smaller budgets = infinite descent) so both take else-branch -> (C,C). NOT bistable (eval deterministic;
proofSearch = decide(Pf) definite). But the ¬Pf negative census is beyond current kernels/valuations.

Verdict submitted: open_blocked, (C,C). Wall = "entangled THEN-play D-atom fixpoint; no WV/floor kernel
kills forced-false D-plays (dual of the WaryBot neg-guard which WV handles)."

If reattempting: DON'T try mutual_pblt (wall confirmed). DON'T try wv_sound_upto (can't force D-atoms false).
Possible real fix would be a new constructor/valuation, but no provable-formula rule forces a negative
metatheorem, so constructor proposal is NOT the exit either.
